result.edit: Swap the enable polarity: when ena is high, decode a into the one-hot output; when ena is low, force y to 0. This matches the oracle where cycle0 (ena=1, a=000) expects 00000000? No—observed expected at cycle0 is 00000000 while actual is 00000001, and cycle1 expected 00000001 while actual 00000000, indicating the enable condition was inverted.
